title: Validate an event stream
goal: Device events become a queryable analytical dataset. Switch the validation outcome to follow the rejected path.

nodes.label: Event producers
nodes.caption: Business event ID + event timestamp
nodes.detail: The producer preserves a stable business identifier and the event timestamp. A retried publish may still need business-level deduplication.

nodes.label: Pub/Sub
nodes.caption: Decoupled event delivery
nodes.detail: Topics and subscriptions separate producer availability from consumer work. Decide retention and replay deliberately.

nodes.label: Dataflow / Beam
nodes.caption: Parse, window and transform
nodes.detail: Define event-time windows and lateness. Inspect processing mode, connector behavior and the sink contract separately.

nodes.label: Validation boundary
nodes.caption: Accepted record or explicit reject
nodes.detail: The illustrative record is checked against a schema and business rule. Invalid records retain an identifier and a reason in a restricted quarantine.

nodes.label: BigQuery curated table
nodes.caption: Accepted analytical output
nodes.detail: Only accepted records follow this path. The production write method and replay strategy must be chosen and tested.

nodes.label: Restricted quarantine
nodes.caption: Controlled exception path
nodes.detail: Retain a minimal record identifier and rejection reason for controlled diagnosis and replay.

success: The sample record passes validation and reaches the curated table. This illustrates a design, not a live Cloud deployment.
failure: The sample record fails validation. It is routed to restricted quarantine; it does not appear in the curated output. A rejected record needs an owner and a repair policy.
scope: Original illustrative architecture. No Cloud services are executed and no latency, price or availability is simulated.

title: Publish a validated batch
goal: A file batch becomes a curated warehouse partition with an explicit quality boundary.

nodes.label: Cloud Storage files
nodes.caption: Immutable input batch ID
nodes.detail: A durable batch reference pins the logical input. Keep a manifest and the agreed replay window.

nodes.label: Serverless Spark
nodes.caption: Transform a pinned batch
nodes.detail: This candidate fits an intermittent Spark workload. Test dependencies and preserve durable outputs outside temporary compute.

nodes.label: BigQuery staging
nodes.caption: Typed intermediate records
nodes.detail: Staging isolates the unvalidated result from downstream publication and supports reconciliation.

nodes.label: Dataform quality gate
nodes.caption: Assertion is a publish dependency
nodes.detail: Check uniqueness, required fields and the business reconciliation rule. The dependency must block publication on failure.

nodes.label: Curated partition
nodes.caption: Publish the agreed data interval
nodes.detail: Publish the validated interval using a safe write contract. Retrying the orchestration must not blindly append duplicate business rows.

nodes.label: Hold publication
nodes.caption: Controlled exception path
nodes.detail: Retain staging and validation evidence. Alert the owner; repair and rerun the intended interval.

success: The batch meets the illustrative quality contract and the curated partition can be published.
failure: The quality check fails. Publication is held while staging and the validation result remain available for diagnosis.
scope: Original illustrative architecture. No Cloud services are executed and no latency, price or availability is simulated.

title: Reconcile a database migration
goal: A snapshot and subsequent changes are validated before an analytical consumer switches.

nodes.label: Source database
nodes.caption: Snapshot + changes
nodes.detail: Inventory the source engine, log access and the agreed consistency boundary.

nodes.label: Datastream
nodes.caption: Supported change capture
nodes.detail: Verify the exact supported source, destination and connectivity. Do not assume all operational migration paths are interchangeable.

nodes.label: Analytical staging
nodes.caption: Versioned change records
nodes.detail: Preserve keys and ordering evidence appropriate to the source. Deletes and repeated updates need an explicit target-state contract.

nodes.label: Reconciliation gate
nodes.caption: Compare an agreed source state
nodes.detail: Counts alone are insufficient. Check keys, deleted records, relevant totals and a consistent cutover boundary.

nodes.label: Consumer cutover
nodes.caption: Switch only after validation
nodes.detail: Record the decision, acceptable lag and rollback. Distinguish analytical replication from an operational database migration.

nodes.label: Hold cutover
nodes.caption: Controlled exception path
nodes.detail: Keep existing readers on their current system while the discrepancy is investigated.

success: The illustrative reconciliation passes; a controlled consumer cutover can proceed under the migration plan.
failure: A reconciliation discrepancy prevents cutover. Investigate the missing or changed records before switching readers.
scope: Original illustrative architecture. No Cloud services are executed and no latency, price or availability is simulated.

title: Trace delegated lake access
goal: A table reader receives authorized results without a direct object-store grant.

nodes.label: Analyst identity
nodes.caption: Query request
nodes.detail: The analyst requests a table query. Discovery in a catalog does not itself authorize this request.

nodes.label: BigLake external table
nodes.caption: Table-level access boundary
nodes.detail: This pattern uses an external BigLake table, not a managed Iceberg write path. Check the exact policy support.

nodes.label: Connection identity
nodes.caption: Retrieve underlying objects
nodes.detail: The connection service account accesses the supported objects. Protect its permissions and keep them scoped.

nodes.label: Access decision
nodes.caption: Authorized data or denied request
nodes.detail: The sample policy decision represents the configured permissions. It is a teaching boundary, not an IAM simulator.

nodes.label: Authorized result
nodes.caption: Read-only external-table query
nodes.detail: Return only the data authorized through this access path. Do not grant direct bucket access just to bypass a denied query.

nodes.label: Access denied
nodes.caption: Controlled exception path
nodes.detail: Retain appropriate audit evidence without exposing the protected record.

success: The sample request is authorized and returns a permitted analytical result.
failure: The sample request is denied. No protected record is returned; investigate the effective identity and policy path.
scope: Original illustrative architecture. No Cloud services are executed and no latency, price or availability is simulated.
